thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx + 429s for hosted API /v1/generate (us-west-2). Error rate 12% over 2m, latency p95 up 3x. Paging: @sarah (oncall)

maya: saw the alert, paging sarah now. anything on monitoring panel?

sarah: on it. grabbing traces. assigning to kevin for rate-limiter check.

kevin: i can look at rate-limiter. quick snapshot: our rate-limiter logs show bursts of `HTTP 429` from gateway at 17:58:34 -> 18:02:00, then upstream retries causing `5xx` from runtime. looks like a new quota policy rolled out ~17:57 by deploy job `deploy-service:v3.4.1`.

anya: FYI support has 3 customer tickets showing degraded responses, one enterprise customer reporting timeouts. logging customer IDs in PagerDuty incident.

ops-bot: Deploy job: deploy-service:v3.4.1 completed at 2026-03-14T17:57:10Z — change: tighten-global-rate-limiter (config `global_qps_per_ip: 50 -> 10`).

sarah: that explains it. new limiter too strict, causing 429s which the client SDK retries aggressively. retries + backoff not working -> queue saturation -> 5xx. mitigation plan: 1) revert limiter config 2) disable aggressive retries at gateway 3) enable fallback model routing to eu-central if us-west saturated. who can revert now?

kevin: i can rollback the limiter config quickly. running command: `kubectl apply -f rate-limiter-config-previous.yaml --namespace=infra`. will taint the rollout to avoid autosync.

maya: i'm going to bump the quota on the rate-limiter as a faster mitigation while rollback proceeds. `rlctl set-global-qps 50`

kevin: applied the bump at 17:59:05Z. monitoring...

ops-bot: Rate limiter updated: global_qps_per_ip=50 (applied by kevin).

incident-bot: Metric update: error rate dropped from 12% -> 4% in 60s; p95 latency back to 1.3x baseline.

sarah: good. next step: temporarily disable gateway-side automatic retries for 429s to prevent retry storm. kev, can you flip that? command: `gatewayctl set-retry-policy --target 429 --enabled=false`

kevin: turned off retries for 429 at 18:00:22Z.

support-bot: Logged customer impact summary: 18 requests failed for customer acme-inc (small fraction, some requests retried successfully). Raising to CSM for outreach: @anya please coordinate.

anya: will draft a message. tentative: "We're investigating elevated errors in us-west-2 between 17:57-18:02 UTC; many retries resolved after config change; if you saw persistent failures please contact support."

maya: we're still seeing isolated 5xx traces where the runtime OOMed due to request retry storm. opened a quick autoscale burst: `asg scale --group runtime-us-west-2 --delta +4` at 18:01:00Z.

ops-bot: ASG scale event: +4 instances (requested by maya).

incident-bot: P95 latency stabilizing. error rate down to 1.1% at 18:03:12Z.

sarah: summary of immediate mitigation: 1) bumped limiter to prior value 2) disabled retries for 429 3) scaled runtime group +4 4) rollback of strict limiter policy scheduled. can we confirm rollback completed?

kevin: rollback completed and locked to prevent re-apply via CI at 18:04:55Z. added a temp block in CI: `ci-lock: rate-limiter-config`.

maya: adding follow-up action items: - postmortem to include change review & safeguard for global rate-limit changes - add server-side guardrail: rate-limiter shouldn't drop more than X% of traffic without a staged rollout - add alert: 429->5xx cascade detector.

sarah: tagging owners: kevin (rate-limiter), maya (autoscale + runtime), anya (customer comms). I'll leave this thread open for 1h for verification, then close with follow-up ticket link. any other issues?

kevin: quick note: logs show `Retry-After` wasn't respected by several client SDKs — we should add throttling hint headers and docs update. filing GH issue #3245.

anya: customer note drafted and sent to CSMs at 18:06:40Z.

support-bot: Ticket count: 3 high-priority, 6 medium. assigned.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. root cause candidate: misapplied global rate-limiter policy from deploy job causing excessive 429s; retries caused cascading 5xx.

sarah: closing immediate paging. leaving action items: postmortem (owner: kevin), config gating (owner: eng-platform), client SDK header doc (owner: docs team). will create JIRA and link here. thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:

kevin: created postmortem ticket INF-2026-017 at 18:12:02Z and linked to this thread.

maya: will follow up on autoscale logs to tune thresholds.

incident-bot: Thread closed to paging at 18:15:00Z.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: from maya, :wave: from anya)
